pages.title: Giving Commands
pages.text: With empty hands, right-click your human-form dragon unless severely injured. This cycles Wander, Rest and Guard. The mode appears on screen; no staff is needed.

pages.title: Three Commands
pages.text: Wander: roam nearby, protect you and your pets, and help with your attacks.$(br2)Rest: stay put, but defend self, owner and pets before resting again.$(br2)Guard: follow the owner and watch for enemies.

pages.title: Interaction Controls
pages.text: With both hands empty, Shift-right-click to open your companion's panel. A normal right-click cycles Wander, Rest, and Guard.$(br2)Hold the appropriate item to feed it or use a horn or staff. Dragon form retains the original staff and riding controls.

pages.title: Following the Owner
pages.text: While guarding, your companion stays near you and teleports closer if left far behind.$(br2)From knowledge level one, both forms seek visible hostile creatures while wandering or guarding. A resting or sleeping dragon leaves them alone, but still rises to defend its companions when threatened.

pages.title: Setting a Home
pages.text: As owner, Shift-right-click your dragon with a dragon staff to set or clear home.$(br2)In Wander, it stays nearby and tries to return for sleep at its usual hour. Guard and Rest take priority; if blocked, it may rest where it is when conditions allow.

pages.title: Sleep and Waking
pages.text: Fire and ice dragons usually sleep at night; lightning dragons often doze during the day. A guarding companion stays awake for you.$(br2)A named, tamed dragon at stage three with 300 knowledge can also wake when it or its owner in the same dimension is hurt.

pages.title: After Recovery
pages.text: If your companion sits after reaching full health, it is waiting for your next command.$(br2)In human form, right-click with empty hands; in dragon form, use a dragon staff. Set out together when ready.

pages.title: Avoiding Hazards
pages.text: The three dragon types choose different paths. Fire dragons tolerate lava but avoid dragon ice spikes; ice dragons cross those spikes but avoid lava. Lightning dragons are wary of both.$(br2)Keep an eye on the ground when traveling through dangerous places.

pages.title: Still Watching Over You
pages.text: An awake, seated fire or ice dragon in human form may watch you or nearby creatures, then look away.$(br2)A companion that meets the waking conditions also wakes to protect you when absorption hearts take the whole hit, before normal health is lost.
